artefacts.name: review.speckit-code
artefacts.description: Review the implementation against the entire spec-driven development documentation set (including the constitution) for compliance; detect and explain drift among code↔spec↔plan↔tasks - provide prioritised, actionable recommendations (including refactoring) to bring all artefacts into alignment

metadata.argumentHint: Optional: scope of code to review (defaults to whole repository)

artefacts.name: review.speckit-documentation
artefacts.description: Review the entire spec-driven development documentation set (including the constitution) for consistency, cohesion, coherence, and traceability; identify issues - provide prioritised, actionable, tech-aligned recommendations to bring all artefacts into alignment

metadata.argumentHint: Optional: documentation artefact to review (defaults to spec/plan/tasks set)

artefacts.name: review.speckit-test
artefacts.description: Review the test automation implementation against the specification and the desired test pyramid shape; detect and explain misalignment - prioritise unit tests, identify high-value gaps and brittle tests, and provide actionable recommendations (including refactoring) to improve behavioural confidence

metadata.argumentHint: Optional: test scope to review (defaults to whole test suite)

artefacts.name: find-bugs
artefacts.description: Find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues in local branch changes. Use when asked to review changes, find bugs, security review, or audit code on the current branch.

artefacts.name: incremental-implementation
artefacts.description: Delivers changes incrementally. Use when implementing any feature or change that touches more than one file. Use when you're about to write a large amount of code at once, or when a task feels too big to land in one step.

artefacts.name: repository-template
artefacts.description: Create code repository from template, or/and update it in parts from the content of the template that contains example of use of tools like make, pre-commit git hooks, Docker, and quality checks.

metadata.argumentHint: Name the capability to add, remove, or improve from the repository template

artefacts.name: security-and-hardening
artefacts.description: Hardens code against vulnerabilities. Use when handling user input, authentication, data storage, or external integrations. Use when building any feature that accepts untrusted data, manages user sessions, or interacts with third-party services.

artefacts.name: spec-consolidation
artefacts.description: Consolidate per-feature Spec Kit artefacts under specs/ into a product-facing specification set aligned to a selected baseline, excluding plan.md and tasks.md from the final output.

metadata.argumentHint: Specify step: spec, data-model, research, quickstart, contracts, checklists, or all. Optional baseline: working-tree, HEAD, or default-branch

artefacts.name: spec-to-code-compliance
artefacts.description: Check code against the documentation that specifies it - which requirements hold, which the code contradicts, which are absent, and what the code does that no document mentions. Use when comparing an implementation against a whitepaper, protocol spec, or design document.

artefacts.name: speckit-analyze
artefacts.description: Perform a non-destructive cross-artifact consistency and quality analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md after task generation.

artefacts.name: speckit-checklist
artefacts.description: Generate a custom checklist for the current feature based on user requirements.

artefacts.name: speckit-clarify
artefacts.description: Identify underspecified areas in the current feature spec by asking up to 5 highly targeted clarification questions and encoding answers back into the spec.

artefacts.name: speckit-constitution
artefacts.description: Create or update the project constitution from interactive or provided principle inputs.

artefacts.name: speckit-converge
artefacts.description: Assess the current codebase against the feature's spec, plan, and tasks, then append any remaining unbuilt work as new tasks to tasks.md so implement can complete it.

artefacts.name: speckit-implement
artefacts.description: Execute the implementation plan by processing and executing all tasks defined in tasks.md

artefacts.name: speckit-plan
artefacts.description: Execute the implementation planning workflow using the plan template to generate design artifacts.

artefacts.name: speckit-specify
artefacts.description: Create or update the feature specification from a natural language feature description.

artefacts.name: speckit-tasks
artefacts.description: Generate an actionable, dependency-ordered tasks.md for the feature based on available design artifacts.

artefacts.name: speckit-taskstoissues
artefacts.description: Convert existing tasks into actionable, dependency-ordered GitHub issues for the feature based on available design artifacts.

artefacts.name: system-documentation
artefacts.description: Establish, synchronise, audit, and review an opinionated repository documentation system across entrypoints, architecture, reference, explanation, tutorials, how-to guides, operations, audience indexes, and governance/lifecycle artefacts.

metadata.argumentHint: Optional: step (foundation, architecture, reference, explanation, how-to, tutorials, operations, audience-indexes, governance, all), mode (establish, sync, audit, pre-pr-review), and scope (path, feature dir, or changed files)

artefacts.name: systematic-debugging
artefacts.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

artefacts.name: test-driven-development
artefacts.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

artefacts.name: using-git-worktrees
artefacts.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

artefacts.name: verification-before-completion
artefacts.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

artefacts.name: virtual-think-tank
artefacts.description: Run a structured multi-step think tank for engineering, architecture, product, process, policy, vendor, or organisational decisions. Use when the user needs conflicting viewpoints, explicit trade-offs, and a forced human decision rather than a one-shot answer.

metadata.argumentHint: Paste a decision brief, or say guided and answer the questions step by step

artefacts.name: writing-skills
artefacts.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
